equal_clock_product_no_go.scope: Assumes standard time rescaling 90/7 and independent equal-clock product; variable q, anisotropy, interactions, dynamical fibers can evade the restricted statement.
equal_clock_product_no_go.theorem: No positive integer tensor power of identical six-copy Pascal limiting diffusions has exact spectral dimension 4 under the standard common-clock scaling.

exact_conductance_fixed_point: only c=0 for c>=0; numerator F(c)-c=-c(15c²+22c+8)/(15c²+31c+15)
literature_scope: Ordinary one-loop asymptotic freedom and dimensional transmutation are established QFT; the exact graph RG and product no-go are restricted mathematical checks, not a complete UV quantum theory.
negative_control: This is a hyperbolic power-law contraction, not a marginal logarithmic beta function; the circuit alone does not generate an exponential transmutation scale.

one_loop_su3_benchmark.one_loop_formula: Lambda/mu=exp(-8*pi²/(b0*g_UV²)); g_UV and mu are externally supplied.

one_loop_su3_benchmark.warning: Choosing g_UV to match a graph ratio is parameter fitting and does not derive a prediction. The 15/7 choice requires alpha close to 1, outside a reliable perturbative regime.

physical_scale_gauge.continuous_time_photonic_model: H=J*L, U(t)=exp(-i J t L/hbar). Dimensionless normalized data fix only tau=Jt/hbar; J and t cannot be separately identified without external calibration.
physical_scale_gauge.electrical_model: R_n scales as 1/g0 for common edge conductance g0; its ratio 15/7 is invariant and cannot fix g0. Physical length ℓ0 is likewise absent.
physical_scale_gauge.parameter_underdetermination: Multiplying all edge conductances by a positive factor leaves the exact resistance ratios unchanged; multiplying J by a and t by 1/a preserves all quantum-walk probabilities.
